# samsungcloudplatformv2_ske_cluster_deletion_protection (Resource)

Manages deletion protection for an SKE cluster. When enabled, the cluster cannot be deleted until protection is disabled.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) Cluster ID
  - example: YOUR RESOURCE'S CLUSTER_ID
- `deletion_protection_enabled` (Boolean) Deletion protection flag. When set to true, cluster deletion is prevented.
  - example: true

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier of the resource.
  - example: YOUR RESOURCE'S ID
- `resource_id` (String) Resource ID returned by the API, or cluster_id as a fallback when the API does not provide one
  - example: YOUR RESOURCE'S RESOURCE_ID
